summary: Part 2 of the Revibe Seller onboarding training (04:19 to 08:29 per the pack header; last spoken line at 08:26). The trainer walks through the Revibe - Fulfillment App (AppSheet, in Chrome): choosing SKUs from SKUs available, filling the Request products form inside a shipment (Quantity Sent, Price), saving, reading the shipment's Related Request_products table, then the sidebar tabs Request products, Supplier inventory, Inventory exits and Packaging request. He ends with the packing rules (bubble wrap, sticker, USB-C cables, box) and the pickup by Quiqup. All 40 frames listed in the pack were opened. Frame-to-narration timing is approximate for the middle screens, so frame file names are cited with the visible content. Open questions are in unclear: the airway bill vs tracking label, the Add button used, the shipment-level Qnt sent (10) vs the line total (15), the error message for a second shipment, and the carrier spelling (Quiqup on screen, Quickup on the slide).

unclear.issue: The trainer says an 'airway bill' will be created and printed one hour after the request (06:25-06:31), but at 08:18-08:26 says a 'tracking label link' appears and is printed. The screen only shows a 'Tracking Label link' column, empty at recording (frames t00323.jpg, t00503.jpg). It is unclear whether these are the same document.

The word '{automatically?}' is unreliable. The narration may say the shipment is requested automatically when the form is saved, or may describe something else. The screen shows only Request Status 'Requested' after saving (frame t00287.jpg).

The pack does not show which Add button was used to open the Request products Form: the Shipments page '+ Add' (tooltip 'Add' in frame t00471.jpg) or the 'Add' under Related Request_products in the shipment detail (frame t00478.jpg). The Form is already open in frame t00276.jpg, so the click is not in the frames.

The shipment-level 'Qnt sent' shows 10 (frames t00287.jpg and t00331.jpg) while the two request lines are 10 and 5 (total 15) and the trainer says 15 pieces. The shipment field may not have updated, or it may count only one line. Not resolved on screen.

The phrase 'if {weekly?} sold your products on the website' is unreliable. The word after 'if' could be 'when', 'we' or another word; the reason for an Inventory exit (a sale) is clear enough, but the exact wording, including whether it is the Revibe website, is not.

The trainer says clicking Add when a shipment already exists shows an error message, but no error message appears in any frame (the only Add frame is the tooltip in t00471.jpg), so the exact text and behaviour are not verified.
The Buybox supplier column (598 and 203) is shown next to Price (597 and 202) but the trainer does not explain it, so its meaning is not stated here.

Carrier spelling differs between sources. The narration says 'quick up' (07:15), the slide says 'Quickup will come and collect' (t00385.jpg, t00405.jpg), and the app and tracking URL say 'Quiqup' (t00272.jpg, t00503.jpg). The app spelling is used in this pack; confirm with the trainer before publishing.
The number '30 to 50 pieces' is spoken only; no frame shows it. The speech-recognition risk on this number cannot be checked on screen.
